LHBP.notes: Budapest (LHBP), Hungary, EUR. AVIANEX invoice V/26/00157 (21 Jul 2026; A6-AFE GLEX 44 t, ALEX group; UAII–LHBP–LJMB, 14 Jul 2026 14:37Z / 15:45Z; USD, VAT 0): handling 2,966.98 (= Euro Jet 277849BUD 2,514.39 EUR × 1.18), supervision 200, disbursement 5% on handling 148.35; total 3,315.33 USD. Euro Jet Intercontinental invoice 277849BUD (20 Jul 2026, billed to Avianex, EUR): landing 667.92, parking 14.08, infrastructure 28.07, ramp handling 778.84, technical handling 85, trash removal 8.50 (third-party subtotal 1,582.41), Euro Jet admin fee 181.98 (11.5% of third party), ground support services 700, communication 50; total 2,514.39. USER DECISIONS (12 Nov 2026): single handler AVIANEX (Euro Jet not opened separately; like LATI / LROP); Euro Jet prices × 1.0522 (Avianex FX 1.18 / panel 1.1215, like LROP); supervision 178.33 (200 USD at panel rate); admin fee 12.075% (11.5% × 1.05) on third-party items only; disbursement 5% excl. supervision; ramp handling, landing and parking only in GL5T (A6-AFE); parking provisional per started hour 14.81; technical handling as tick row; ground support, communication and trash in basket; green / verified to wait for more invoices. CELEBI AVIATION (General Aviation Terminal Budapest, gat@celebiaviation.hu) e-mail quote 24 Nov 2026 (EUR): handling GLEX (43,545 kg) 1,147, E35L (24,300 kg) 823; disbursement 10% on third-party services; handling activity fee 0.64 per ton; pushback / towing 149; GPU 58.08 per 15 min; lavatory 65.34; potable water 65.34; conveyor belt 83.50; minimum service fee 136 per departing pax; landing 10–45 t 15.18 per ton, above 45 t 12.88 per ton; parking 06–22 h first 45 min 0.20 per 1,000 kg, every further minute 0.01 per 1,000 kg, 22:00–06:00 free; deep sleep fee 1,500–4,000 for operations 00:00–05:00 LT. Euro Jet invoice 277849BUD confirms landing 44 t × 15.18 = 667.92 and infrastructure 28.07 ≈ 0.64 × 44 t (same fee). USER DECISIONS (25 Nov 2026): handler CELEBI AVIATION, type FBO; handling CL60 and E35L 823, GL7T / GLEX / GL5T / GLF4 1,147; started tons, GLEX group at 46 t (GL6T 45,132 kg), GL7T 53 t; landing above 45 t tiered (45 t × 15.18 + rest × 12.88); handling activity fee entered in the infrastructure fee row; disbursement 10% on airport fees; deep sleep fee as night surcharge 1,500 per movement 00:00–05:00 (up to 4,000); minimum service fee per departing pax in basket. JETMATE (flight support; JetMate Aviation FZE) invoices for A6-AFC GLEX (AED): JMFS-2600529016461 (29 May 2026, LSGG–LHBP–LKPR, 0 pax): ground handling 5,081.21, handling activity fee 127.19, waste 46.52, GAT charges 243.65, communication 183.65, disbursement 454.58, bank 91.83, arrangement 367.30 (total 6,595.93); JMFS-2600529017035 (airport fees 3,052.16 + disbursement 244.17); JMFS-2600529017036 (31 May 2026, LKPR–LHBP–OEJN, 4 pax): ground handling 5,058.27, handling surcharge 626.44, airport fees 3,963.97, baggage handling 4 × 40.57, handling activity fee 126.61, GAT service 4 × 542.96, waste 46.31, extra GAT charge 242.55, communication 183.65, disbursement 1,006.55, bank 91.83, arrangement 367.30 (total 14,047.60). Underlying: Celebi invoices 2026000000001949 (handling pack 1,147, handling activity fee 45 × 0.638 = 28.71, waste 10.50, extra GAT UEFA charge 55) and 2026000000002724 (handling 1,147, surcharge 142.05, baggage 4 × 24.20 less discount 4 × 15, activity 28.71, GAT pax minimum service fee 4 × 123.12, waste 10.50, extra GAT UEFA 55); Budapest Airport invoices 2026412878 (landing 45 t 683.10, parking 9.00) and 2026416130 (landing 683.10, parking 12.60, GAT passenger service 4 × 44.47, GAT security departing pax 4 × 6.32). JetMate converts at 4.43 (Celebi items, 29 May) / 4.41 AED per EUR; disbursement 8% on all items incl. communication, not on bank charges and arrangement fee; communication 50, bank 25, arrangement 100 USD. USER DECISIONS (25 Nov 2026): handler JETMATE, type FLIGHT SUPPORT, in EUR at panel rate (Celebi items × 1.0756, airport items × 1.0707); handling GLEX only; Celebi surcharge 142.05 (31 May, Sunday; basis unknown) in notes only, to be asked; UEFA event charge not entered; GAT passenger service and security charges common to Celebi; JetMate GAT pax minimum fee from its own invoice (123.12 × 1.0756); Celebi weights as invoiced (whole tons; GLEX 45 t, E35L 24 t, GL7T 52 t), activity fee kept at quote 0.64; Celebi waste 10.50 from its invoices.
